List of all members.

Detailed Description

Class containing the instance for coverage groups class. These groups are setup to use the default coverage data provided by the svt_mipi_cphy_serial_monitor_def_cov_data_callback class, with sampling triggered by the events triggered by the svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction_cov_data class.
